author: xNemoII
body:
Sqooks is the alt of iiiOmega (he even admitted to saying this)

As you can see on the account 'iiiOmega' he is unbanned after 6/7 months. Which means he got unbanned around December.

But on his alt account 'Sqooks' it says that he joined 'about 2 months ago' on 'November 17th 2016 at 6:53pm' (this is GMT timezone btw) https://avicus.net/sqooks http://imgur.com/a/S5Xuc
So since he got unbanned at around december 2016 (you can check his appeal when he got unbanned if you dont believe me) and his alt joined at november 17th 2016 this surely means he has ban evaded in the past before he got unbanned

replies.body:
Hello xNemoII,

Thanks for the report.
Unfortunately the accounts don't link to each other. It might just be coincidence that Sqooks joined at the same time iiiOmega was banned.
If you have more evidence feel free to create a new report!

The report is denied.

Regards Flo/resepignev :D
